A SpringConstraint applies a force to its Attachment based on spring and damper behavior. Assuming the SpringConstraint has non-zero stiffness, it will apply forces based on how far apart the Attachments are. If the Attachments are further apart than the FreeLength then the Attachments will be forced together. If they are closer than the FreeLength then the Attachments will be forced apart. In addition, if Damping is set then there will be a component to the applied force that's proportional and opposite to the velocity of the attachments.
